tests.environment: Disposable local PostgreSQL17.6 and existing received synthetic10k portfolio; no Aiven or real model claim

integrationRequirements: Integrator alone applies canonical SQL, imports data, resolves principal and current basis, assembles existing worker and implements report/approval/execution

Call parseIndustrialContext(value,snapshot) for strict pure DTO/native relation validation; call currentIndustrialContext(value,snapshot,asOf) for the current positive context served to domain/model. The returned DTO is detached from inputs.
All trigger methods except read-only bounded listReady require a client inside the caller transaction. The module locks company before mutation.
resolvePrincipal and validateBasis are mandatory trusted SQL checks; principal must be active analysis_only for that company. No impersonation of Paul and no approval authority.
enqueue is called in the transaction that publishes a received qualified event/source basis. A freshness extension alone is not a new source identity.
promote uses the existing-worker enqueueRun SQL callback in that same transaction; maxRunsPerEvent persists across all versions of the event.
Commit reserveUsage before every actual provider or tool call and execute that effect outside SQL. Counters and elapsed deadline are durable; never reset on restart.
Root reconciles interrupted runs as uncertain and preserves previous approved/executed history; this data module neither restarts uncertain calls nor executes purchases/transfers.
Finish checks current principal/basis and persistent duration before done. Root atomically publishes a report only after its own final current-basis validation.
Research4pin module stays frozen. For analysis_only, pass server-received public refs/context and validate dependencies server-side; its human actor lookup/refresh roles are not implicitly extended.
